artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan threading roadmap_path into every implementation-agent dispatch context, adding a read-only roadmap-load stage plus a directive Stage 6a to both implementation agents, adding a distinct roadmap_no_match signal to /todo, an end-to-end fixture test, and deploy regeneration with full gate run.

memory_candidates.content: When an agent contract instructs a subagent to make a judgment against an external document (e.g. 'only include X if it clearly maps to a roadmap item'), the instruction is inert unless some dispatch stage actually loads that document into the subagent's context. Diagnosing a dead feature of this shape means checking the delegation-context plumbing, not the instruction text. Corollary for this codebase: threading a new delegation field to implementation agents requires editing BOTH the implementer skills (skill-implementer, skill-implementer-hard) AND the orchestrator skills (skill-orchestrate, skill-orchestrate-hard), because /orchestrate dispatches $IMPLEMENT_AGENT directly with its own inline context objects and never passes through skill-implementer's Stage 4. Editing only the implementer skills leaves the field dead on every /orchestrate run.
